role: Non-author of the new P8-003 external recovery script and its original p8_compat driver; reviewed source via GitHub API.

checks.result: import-oce --queries/--metadata/--output, freeze --suite and validate --suite match the fixed Rust CLI. imported.with_suffix('.receipt.json') matches Rust with_extension('receipt.json'). Actual import checks reference commit and 100-question count.

Suite directories and drift-copy directories are siblings of pinned source roots under inputs. '../<repository>' continues to point at the same verified clean Git checkout. Questions stay outside indexed source.

Whole original artifact archive and every extracted tool/helper are pinned by byte count and SHA256. Clones verify exact commit, full tree, clean status, no submodules and tracked regular Git blob bytes/modes. Additional current cc-eval exclusions fail closed instead of silently changing the input set. These checks are source-inspected, not executed in this review.

Lock keys match original inspect_lock, including ten scorer inputs, platform, suite/source/query hashes, exact auto_index false, original evaluator and backend receipts. top_k=10, repetitions=3, warmup=0, timeout_ms=30000, seed=20261003 and 600s commands remain fixed. Original per-profile raw limits and run/replay gate conditions remain in the extracted unmodified wrapper.

Query field order, AnswerGroup and Alternative insertion order and sorted BTreeMap annotations match the fixed Rust serde structs and to_writer newline framing. Exact actual runner queries.jsonl equality is a mandatory runtime check; no static assumption can bypass a serialization mismatch.

Generic native validation permits primary grade2/secondary grade1 and explicit path alternatives. This is a declared mechanical projection of original expected-file ordering. Native top1 requires a primary hit, while compatibility top1 accepts any matched expected file; the script separately reports profiles and does not claim metric equivalence or independently reviewed semantic gold.

Both repositories and both profiles execute the original Rust validator against isolated modified query copies, require exit 2 and original content-lock error text, and verify original query bytes unchanged. Fixed load checks content digests before query scoring. Controls remain required even in prepare-only mode.

Actual query snapshots are external recipes, other exact full question representations are factored into external references, payload digests and original per-file bytes/hashes are retained, immediate restoration is private, and all restored files must equal same-run original bytes. Package is explicitly not an original raw ZIP. No third-party question bodies were fetched or read by this review.

Ordinary ubuntu-24.04 Actions uses read-only permissions, no persisted checkout credential, syntax parse before execution, the fixed original artifact download, separate private/public directories, actual original runner, and always uploads only public results/references. Nonzero command/gate failures remain nonzero; no continue-on-error or task-state promotion.

limitations: Review is static source/interface inspection, not a replacement for actual artifact verification, cloned inventories, four negative controls, run/replay outputs or restoration equality.
Native gold remains mechanical and unreviewed; no independent semantic quality or file/facet/span/graph acceptance is granted.
P8-002 hard dependency and P8-003 original acceptance remain unchanged. Historical inaccessible local outputs are not relabeled as new runs.
The private/public path separation is reviewed for the provided fresh GitHub Actions directories; no arbitrary hostile filesystem deployment is claimed.
